title: Watercolor 20 Goldenrod Circle #301
description_expanded: HOME HIGHLIGHTS:*Per Watercolor HOA, please include all guests aged 5 and older in your total count of adult guests to receive amenity and pool access wristbands. Sleep arrangements are provided as a courtesy and are not considered in the occupancy count.**This home is allowed 6 amenity access bands.**- Located in the Towncenter District of WaterColor- Access to community pools, nature trails, and dune lakes- Conveniently located near Publix & restaurants- Balcony with Gulf views- Washer/Dryer- 2 adult bikes provided- Complete Clean Linen Participant - ALL linens, including comforter covers, are laundered upon every checkoutGuests staying in WaterColor will have access to the newly expanded WaterColor Beach Club. It features a new main pool and lounge area, second pool deck with additional lounge seating, and third pool with zero-entry, as well an enhanced WaterColor Grill, and new sunset bar, Costa Chica. All have scenic views of the Gulf of Mexico.DETAILS: Goldenrod Circle #301 is a contemporary 2-bedroom, 2-bathroom condo. Located in the inviting WaterColor neighborhood, this home is only steps away from the private WaterColor Beach Club and other amenities, including the tennis center and multiple community pools. This beautifully maintained condo offers high-end furnishings and stunning views of the Gulf.Located on the top floor, this stylish condo can be accessed via an elevator. From there, guests can enter this single-story unit that opens to a blended living and dining area with 10-foot ceilings, large pieces of artwork, and a wall of windows with great natural lighting. Relax and unwind while watching TV with loved ones on the queen sleeper sofa and 4 matching linen armchairs before sitting down at the 6-seat dining table for dinner—turn on the Sonos speakers for elegant ambiance. Next to the table is the 3-stool breakfast bar and kitchen pass-through, making it easy to entertain guests as the host cooks on the stainless-steel GE appliances a few feet away. Gorgeous Gulf views can be enjoyed while sitting on the porch swing of the covered balcony, accessible from both the living area and primary bedroom. With 2 bedrooms on this floor, guests can sleep peacefully on 2 full-sized beds in the guest bedroom or 1 king-sized bed in the primary bedroom. There is also a full-sized washer and dryer in the hallway for convenience.2 adult bikes are included with the condo. Explore nearby Western Lake, and all of 30A with ease. Don’t wait! Goldenrod Circle #301 will book fast. Book today!SLEEPING ARRANGEMENTS:- Primary Bedroom: King Bed, Private Bathroom with Shower and Tub- Guest Bedroom: Two Full Beds, Shared Bathroom with Shower Only- Sleeper SofaWeddings are not allowed at this home. If this policy is violated, you may be asked to vacate the property and forfeit any rental payments, as well as be subject to HOA, community, and 360 Blue fines.*Watercolor Community HOA prohibits the rental of Low-Speed Vehicles for guests staying in the Town Center.
